title: Read the following three primary source excerpts and answer the prompt below.

documents.label: A
documents.citation: Warren G. Harding, "Return to Normalcy" campaign speech, Boston, Massachusetts, May 14, 1920 (Congressional Record, public domain)
documents.excerpt: America's present need is not heroics but healing; not nostrums but normalcy; not revolution but restoration; not agitation but adjustment; not surgery but serenity; not the dramatic but the dispassionate; not experiment but equipoise; not submergence in internationality but sustainment in triumphant nationality.

documents.label: B
documents.citation: A. Mitchell Palmer, "The Case Against the Reds," Records of the Department of Justice, National Archives (archives.gov), February 1920 (National Archives, Record Group 60 (archives.gov), public domain)
documents.excerpt: The Department of Justice will pursue…not only those persons who commit overt acts against the Government, but also those who advocate the overthrow of our institutions by force or violence…The Red movement has its headquarters in this country, is financed by the alien enemy, and its purpose is to spread its communistic propaganda by any and every means.

documents.label: C
documents.citation: Immigration Act of 1924 (Johnson-Reed Act), Congressional findings, 68th Congress (U.S. Statutes at Large, public domain)
documents.excerpt: It is the sense of the Congress that the racial composition of the American people should be maintained; and the President is authorized and requested to make representations accordingly to foreign governments.
